forwardOnlyRecovery.model: STAGE-MF-08. A restoration is a NEW forward migration with a later canonical version; a re-application is ANOTHER new forward version. No ledger row is ever deleted or rewritten.
forwardOnlyRecovery.differsFromFirstRun: the first run exercised recovery by running the rollback SCRIPTS directly, which is the old model. This run exercises the accepted forward-only model end to end.

observedDuringRestoration.finding: after restoration, anon still holds SELECT on flag_comments, where this branch's true pre-apply baseline had none
observedDuringRestoration.cause: the rollback scripts are UNSAFE_BASELINE_RESTORE and restore a MODELLED baseline authored against production's real posture (109 anon grants). This branch's actual baseline, built from the 71 source migrations, grants anon nothing.
observedDuringRestoration.relation: this is PRIVILEGE-BASELINE-DIVERGENCE (recorded pre-apply) showing up concretely in the round trip
observedDuringRestoration.consequence: a production rollback would restore production's posture, which is the intent. On this branch it overshoots the local baseline. Not a defect in the candidate; a property of testing a production-authored rollback against a migration-derived branch.
